title: The Cold Safehouse
author: Yara Fairweather
blurb: Ivo Ishikawa, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
